title: Concept Case Bridge
user: Professionals learning both a technical stack and an unfamiliar business domain who need to practice choosing the right concept in a realistic domain case.
smallest_useful_product: Local case-card editor: author a compact scenario, tag the technical concept and domain signal, hide the decision, and review with a 'why not the alternative?' field.
success_measure: Pilot users create 15+ concept-case links and correctly choose the intended concept in 75% of delayed case checks after two weeks.
constraints: Do not include employer-confidential facts in templates; local-only default; authored cases need clear attribution/export.
